quest.title: Stolen Tears
quest.description: The corrupted dragon tear has even attracted hilichurls. You must get it back from them.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x20, Mora x6000, Character EXP x3125, Fine Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Go to the Eclipse Tribe at Dadaupa Gorge

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are too many enemies ahead! <color=#00E1FFFF>Attacking</color> them head on would be too dangerous. Maybe we can creep down <color=#00E1FFFF>either side</color> to sneak past.

talks.objective: Open the chest to obtain Dvalin's Tear

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: This search reminds me of a feud I once had with the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our only objective is the Teardrop Crystal. Should we <color=#00E1FFFF>attack them head-on</color> or <color=#00E1FFFF>sneak inside</color>? It's up to you!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Six months ago, a thief stole treasure from the East Temple of the Four Winds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa. What was it? A cup used by Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: No. Although if such a thing existed, it would be very valuable.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Among all the relics they managed to dig up, one particular object was very rare...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: It was a vial which contained the Anemo God's breath.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Relics come in every shape and form huh...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Anyone with an eye for fine art would like to add this relic to their collection.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Once word got out, the Fatui started trying to seek it out as well.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: They've made tons of counterfeits that can be found everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: In response, I just bought every one I could find, irrespective of its authenticity. We're still at it now.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: I've bought more than two thousand fakes to date, and the Fatui are yet to find the real one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, it means that the real one must be out there somewhere on the black market, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmmm... Paimon'll give you a discount on them if she finds any — cause Paimon's just great like that!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Sure, you can try to find the real one. I'll take what you find, even if they're fake.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Once you're done, find me at the winery. I'll trade you a beer for every 20 you find.
